metadata.title: Integrated Steady-State Axis Framework: Evidence Database & Cross-Modal Mapping
metadata.description: Evidence database (120 entries: 29 with verified DOIs, 91 synthetic validation fixtures) and cross-modal terminology mapping for the eight-axis integrated steady-state framework (A-H). Includes: (1) case evidence database with per-entry DOI verification status, (2) four-way terminology mapping (GB/T 20348 <-> axes <-> pathways <-> classical texts), (3) 613 classical Chinese medicine text fragments with axis annotations, (4) eight-axis threshold configuration (externalized), (5) validation baseline snapshot for reproducibility. All upstream bibliographic fields have been audited via three independent fail-loud defenses against leakage. Evidence coverage rate 24.2% (29/120 verified) is honestly reported.

files.description: Case evidence database (120 entries: 29 verified DOIs, 91 synthetic validation fixtures). Schema documented in data/README.
Four-way terminology mapping: GB/T 20348-2026 <-> eight axes (A-H) <-> Western pathways <-> classical texts.
613 classical Chinese medicine text fragments with axis annotations. Each entry marked needs_expert_review=true. Retained bibliographic fields (book/author/dynasty/entity) carry explicit rationale.
DOI verification results via Crossref (2026-10-13). Status: verified / hallucination_resolved / unverified_text / traditional / broken_citation / synthetic_validation / unsourced.
Eight-axis threshold configuration (externalized from code). Supports jurisdiction-specific overrides.
Compute validation baseline snapshot. Metrics: overall_score / calibration_mean / calibration_p5_p95 / n_bootstrap / n_bridges / evalue_mean / calibration.
